channel.title: GA on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in GA on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Summarized advertised gateway prefixes for route advertisement
item.description:
Azure Gateway now generally supports advertising summarized (aggregated) prefixes to on-premises networks instead of advertising every individual virtual network prefix. This is available for route advertisement in Azure gateways.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Databricks Lakebase in four additional regions
item.description:
Azure Databricks Lakebase is now generally available in four additional Azure regions: North Central US, France Central, Germany West Central, and East Asia. This increases deployment options and regional availability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-August 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added customizable keyboard shortcuts for Quick Queries, the Results Grid, and the Query Editor in Visual Studio Code. The changes can be configured directly in the editor.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents on Microsoft Marketplace
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace is now a new channel for discovering, evaluating, and purchasing Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents. The availability applies to Dragon Copilot customers in the United States.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Control plane metrics collection for AKS with Managed Prometheus
item.description:
Control plane metrics collection for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with Azure Monitor Managed Service for Prometheus is now generally available. It provides native observability into key managed control plane components.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Live Resize for Shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Data Disks
item.description:
Live Resize is now generally available for shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks. It lets you expand disk capacity dynamically without application disruption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Batch rule updates for Azure Front Door
item.description:
Batch rule updates are now generally available for Azure Front Door Standard and Premium. The feature lets customers add, update, delete, or reorder multiple rules in a rule set as a single coordinated operation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Unity AI Gateway on Azure Databricks
item.description:
Unity AI Gateway is now generally available on Azure Databricks. It provides centralized governance for AI models, agents, tools, and MCP services, with controls for monitoring usage, managing costs, applying guardrails, and enforcing access control.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Explicit proxy in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall explicit proxy is now generally available. It lets customers configure applications and browsers to send HTTP and HTTPS traffic directly to Azure Firewall through proxy settings, instead of relying on route-based traffic forwarding.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network routing appliance
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network routing appliance is now generally available. It provides private connectivity across virtual networks using specialized hardware designed for low latency, high throughput, and improved performance versus virtual machines.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Trusted Launch as Default
item.description:
Trusted Launch as Default is now generally available for new Azure Gen2 virtual machines and virtual machine scale sets. It automatically enables Secure Boot and vTPM for supported deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Immutability to the most recent seven days of backups on Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance now automatically apply immutability to the most recent seven days of backups. The feature is enabled by default for all databases, regardless of the configured point-in-time restore retention.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Migrate from GitLab to GitHub with GitHub Enterprise Importer
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Importer now generally supports self-serve migrations from gitlab.com and GitLab Self-Managed to GitHub Enterprise Cloud. The feature is available through GEI and the GitHub CLI.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Single-click purchase for public SaaS offers
item.description:
Eligible SaaS products in Microsoft Marketplace now support a single-page purchase flow in the Azure portal. Buyers can review plan, billing, resource group, contact details, and terms before completing the purchase.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37 Sneak Peek
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 is planning several deprecations and a few feature graduations. Notable changes include deprecating kubectl run -f, forbidding Static Pods from referencing Secrets/ConfigMaps, starting deprecation of kube-proxy ipvs mode, and moving SELinuxMount to GA with possible workload impact.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server in India South Central
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server is now generally available in the India South Central Azure region. Users can deploy new flexible server instances in that region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Agent skills and MCP now generally available
item.description:
Copilot code review now generally supports agent skills and MCP servers for all Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise users. These features have moved from public preview to general availability.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Resource placement in Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager
item.description:
Resource placement in Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager is now generally available. It lets users define where Kubernetes resources should be scheduled across multiple clusters to reduce manual work and improve consistency.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Claude Opus 5 on Azure Databricks
item.description:
Azure Databricks now supports Anthropic Claude Opus 5 through AI Model Serving. The update makes the model available for advanced reasoning, coding, agentic workflows, and professional knowledge work.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: HTTP header insertion in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall now supports inserting or overwriting HTTP/HTTPS request headers from application rules. This lets organizations enforce security controls and support tenant restriction at the firewall layer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: aks: Release 2026-07-17
item.description:
AKS v20260717 adds Artifact Streaming GA, new preview networking and scheduling features, and multiple behavior changes and bug fixes. It also updates Kubernetes patch versions, core add-ons, node images, and includes several retirement notices and upcoming defaults.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: github: Copilot cloud agent for Linear is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub says Copilot cloud agent is now generally available for Linear. Users can assign Linear issues to the agent, which then analyzes the issue contents and works asynchronously in the background.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: IPv6 support for Azure VPN Gateway
item.description:
Azure VPN Gateway now supports IPv6 inner traffic in dual-stack VPN tunnels. The feature is available on all production SKU gateways that use standard public IPs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions support for Python 3.14
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports Python 3.14 for local development and deployment to Linux-based Azure Functions plans. This lets apps move to Python 3.14 for security, longer support, and continued compatibility.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Defender security assessments for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
item.description:
Microsoft Defender CSPM assessments for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server are now generally available. The assessments can be used to continuously evaluate the security posture of PostgreSQL flexible servers in Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Encryption in Transit for Azure Files NFS Shares in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
item.description:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) now generally supports Encryption in Transit for Azure Files NFS v4.1 volumes through the Azure File CSI driver. When enabled, data transferred between AKS workloads and Azure Files NFS shares is encrypted in transit.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Advanced search for Projects is generally available
item.description:
GitHub Projects views now support advanced search in the filter bar. You can combine conditions with logical AND and OR to build more precise views without maintaining a separate setup.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: GitHub Copilot and Claude Code connectors in Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now includes generally available connectors for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code. These connectors let .NET and Python agents delegate coding tasks to either system without custom adapter code.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Multi-agent orchestration patterns including Magentic in Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework is now generally available for multi-agent orchestration patterns, including the dynamic Magentic pattern. The announcement cites benchmark results for Magentic, including 38% on GAIA and competitive results on AssistantBench and WebArena.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Databricks SQL Serverless in UK West
item.description:
Azure Databricks SQL Serverless is now generally available in the UK West region starting July 13, 2026. Eligible UK West workspaces can use it for analytics workloads with instant compute, automated scaling, and less infrastructure management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Network Security Perimeter support for Azure Event Hubs
item.description:
Azure Event Hubs now generally supports Network Security Perimeter (NSP). This lets organizations define a logical network isolation boundary for PaaS resources and control public network access using perimeter-based access rules.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Confidential Computing support for Azure Event Hubs Dedicated
item.description:
Azure Event Hubs Dedicated now supports Confidential Computing. It uses hardware-based trusted execution environments to help protect streaming data while it is processed in memory.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Red Hat OpenShift in Chile Central
item.description:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now generally available in Azure Chile Central. This adds support for OpenShift deployments in Microsoft’s first Azure region in Chile and expands availability in South America.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Restrict who can dismiss reviews in rulesets
item.description:
GitHub repository rulesets now support restricting who can dismiss pull request reviews. The feature is generally available and lets you control which users can clear review requirements.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Support 5x churn in Azure Site Recovery
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports up to 5x churn, or 500 MB/s per VM. This increases disaster recovery support for high-IOPS workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally available: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 on Azure Databricks
item.description:
Azure Databricks now supports Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 via AI Model Serving. The update says the model offers near-Opus-level intelligence with Sonnet-level cost efficiency and speed.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Enterprise managed-settings.json is generally available
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud now supports AI standards configuration through a managed-settings.json file stored in a .github-private repository within a selected organization. This gives enterprises a centralized way to define governance and related settings.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot vision is generally available
item.description:
Copilot Vision is now generally available. You can attach images and PDFs to chat prompts so Copilot can use them alongside your code when responding.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: New Powershell module: Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer
item.description:
Azure announced the generally available Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer PowerShell module, a renamed module for managing Azure Database for PostgreSQL with PowerShell. It replaces the previous Az.PostgreSql-related module naming with a more streamlined experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Toolboxes in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Toolboxes are now generally available. They provide a unified endpoint for commonly used tools in prompt agents and can also be invoked outside prompt agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Claude Sonnet 5 is generally available for GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Claude Sonnet 5 is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it offers strong coding performance for everyday development and agentic workflows as a new Sonnet-class model option.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: MAI-Code-1-Flash for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise
item.description:
MAI-Code-1-Flash, Microsoft AI’s in-house coding model, is now generally available for GitHub Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise. It builds on its recent expansion across Copilot surfaces and is described as purpose-built for coding and optimized.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: aks: Release - 2026-06-19
item.description:
AKS 2026-06-19 adds Kubernetes 1.36 GA/LTS, Application Gateway for Containers GA, and several platform updates including FIPS on Ubuntu 22.04, CVM with Azure Linux GA, and multiple CSI/CNI/component patch upgrades. It also changes some defaults and validations, including Istio CNI behavior for new asm-1-30 installs, dual-stack IPv6 CIDR derivation, and stricter checks for gMSA and FIPS/Kata combinations.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Databricks native read access to Microsoft OneLake
item.description:
Azure Databricks now has generally available native read access to Microsoft OneLake through Unity Catalog. Users can query and analyze OneLake data directly without moving or copying it.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: ICMP Support for Azure Standard V2 NAT Gateway
item.description:
Azure StandardV2 NAT Gateway now supports outbound ICMP Echo Request and Echo Reply traffic. This lets customers use tools like ping to validate outbound connectivity and troubleshoot network issues from workloads behind the gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app is now generally available on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It serves as a native desktop app for agent-driven development on GitHub.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Code Quality generally available July 20, 2026
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality, currently in public preview, will reach general availability on July 20, 2026. The preview has been used by enterprises to detect maintainability and reliability issues, enforce quality gates, and track code coverage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Entra server principals on Azure SQL Database
item.description:
Microsoft Entra server principals (logins) for Azure SQL Database are now generally available. You can now create logins with CREATE LOGIN ... FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER in the virtual master database, aligning Microsoft Entra identities with SQL logins.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: PostgreSQL Hub for Azure Developers
item.description:
PostgreSQL Hub for Azure Developers is now generally available. It provides a centralized set of AI and application development resources for PostgreSQL on Azure, including sample apps, solution accelerators, tutorials, and learning paths.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure NC RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition v6 Series Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure NCv6-series virtual machines are now generally available in Southeast Asia and West US 2. They use NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs with 96 GB of memory per GPU.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Premium SSD v2 disks now support non-zonal Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure Premium SSD v2 disks are now generally available for non-zonal, single-instance Azure virtual machines in select regions that have Availability Zones. This lets customers deploy Premium SSD v2 without choosing an Availability Zone.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Maintenance control for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - reschedule, apply on demand, view and download
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server maintenance control is generally available. The update adds the ability to reschedule maintenance, apply it on demand, and view/download maintenance details.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Ingest OTLP signals into Azure Monitor with the OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description:
Azure Monitor now generally supports native ingestion of OTLP signals. OpenTelemetry-instrumented applications and platforms can send telemetry directly to Azure Monitor.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Discovery
item.description:
Microsoft Discovery is now generally available. It provides an enterprise platform for building and governing agentic AI workflows for research and development across scientific and engineering disciplines.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Foundry IQ
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry IQ is now generally available. It provides a managed knowledge layer for grounding agents in enterprise data, with connectors to sources such as SharePoint, OneLake, and Azure Blob.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Private Connectivity for Azure AI Search and Foundry Knowledge Bases
item.description:
Azure AI Search and Foundry Knowledge Bases now support private end-to-end network connectivity between search resources and Foundry services. Traffic for ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, and agent operations can be routed over Shared Private Link or Network Security Perimeter.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Monitor Service Level Indicators (SLI)
item.description:
Azure Monitor now supports Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) in general availability. The feature helps teams measure application experience using customer-facing metrics rather than only infrastructure signals.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Self-serve custom photo avatar creation in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry has generally available self-serve custom photo avatar creation in the Foundry NextGen fine-tuning portal. It is aimed at enterprise customers building voice agents or avatar-and-speech content who need a branded avatar.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Red Hat OpenShift in Belgium Central
item.description:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now generally available in Azure Belgium Central. This adds a new European region for fully managed OpenShift deployments on Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Custom Voice portal experience in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Azure AI Speech’s Custom Voice authoring experience is now generally available in the Microsoft Foundry portal. Approved customers can upload voice talent recordings and consent statements, run data quality checks, and train neural voices in the portal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Foundry for Visual Studio Code (June Build 2026 refresh)
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry for Visual Studio Code is now generally available with a Build 2026 refresh. The update adds the full model catalog, model playground, and Hosted agent deployment directly in the editor.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server: DuckDB extension
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now supports installing the DuckDB extension. The update notes that the feature is generally available.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: File share centric management model (Microsoft.FileShares) for Azure Files
item.description:
The file share-centric management model for Azure Files is now generally available for NFS 4.1 shares on SSD storage. It uses the Microsoft.FileShares resource provider and makes file shares top-level Azure resources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Management Premium v2 and Standard v2 now support wildcard custom hostnames.
item.description:
Azure API Management Premium v2 and Standard v2 now support wildcard custom hostnames. This lets you use a wildcard domain and certificate for subdomains, reducing per-hostname setup and certificate management overhead.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Voice Live integration with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service is now generally available for Voice Live integration. Developers can connect real-time speech-to-text and text-to-speech to a Foundry Agent without building a custom audio pipeline.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Azure Container Linux (ACL) now generally available on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
item.description:
Azure Container Linux (ACL) is now generally available for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) node pools. It provides a minimal, immutable, container-focused host OS based on Flatcar Container Linux and Azure Linux RPM packages.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Event Grid - MQTT v5 Subscription Identifier
item.description:
Azure Event Grid Standard Namespace now generally supports MQTT v5 subscription identifiers. MQTT subscriptions can include an identifier that is delivered with incoming messages for immediate event routing.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Sphere OS version 26.06 is now available
item.description:
Azure Sphere OS version 26.06 is now available in the Retail feed. This release updates the OS only; there is no SDK update.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Github Copilot modernization
item.description:
GitHub Copilot modernization agent is now generally available. It provides coordinated orchestration from estate to code to help scale application assessments and upgrades across an app portfolio.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: OpenTelemetry Metrics, Visualizations, and Enhanced Monitoring in Azure Monitor for Azure VMs and Arc Servers
item.description:
Azure Monitor for Azure VMs and Arc Servers now generally available with OpenTelemetry metrics and visualizations, providing a unified monitoring experience. The release consolidates key monitoring capabilities into a single experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Rolling updates in Flex Consumption
item.description:
Rolling updates are now generally available in Azure Functions Flex Consumption. They allow code and configuration changes to be applied without force-restarting all instances, enabling zero-downtime deployments with a simple configuration change.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Adaptive custom translation in the Azure AI Foundry NextGen playground
item.description:
Adaptive Custom Translation (AdaptCT) is now generally available in the Azure AI Foundry NextGen playground for Azure Translator. It lets enterprises adapt translations to domain-specific terminology using small datasets.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure AI Translator SDKs for the latest text translation API
item.description:
Azure AI Translator has released generally available SDKs for the latest text translation REST API. The GA SDKs are available for C#/.NET, Java, JavaScript, and Python.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Management adds support for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) APIs
item.description:
Azure API Management now supports Agent-to-Agent (A2A) APIs in general availability. The update is intended to bring agent traffic under existing API governance and management controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Management now supports AI gateway capabilities for Anthropic and Vertex AI models.
item.description:
Azure API Management is now generally available with AI gateway capabilities for Anthropic and Vertex AI models. The feature adds centralized controls for securing, governing, and observing model interactions across these external AI providers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Management Premium v2 now supports multiple custom domains
item.description:
Azure API Management Premium v2 now supports multiple custom domains. This lets organizations use different branded domains for APIs, developer portals, and management endpoints.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB all versions and deletes change feed mode
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB’s all versions and deletes change feed mode is now generally available. It exposes every change in a container, rather than only the latest state shown by the default mode.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB global secondary indexes
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB global secondary indexes are now generally available. They provide read-only containers that stay synchronized with the source data to improve query performance without requiring application code changes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Linux emulator (vNext)
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB Linux emulator (vNext) is now generally available. It provides a cross-platform, Docker-based local emulator for development and testing against Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server self-service quota management experience
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server now supports self-service quota management in the Azure Quotas blade. Users can view current usage and limits and request quota changes from the Azure portal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for MySQL now available in new regions and expanded availability zones
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server is now generally available in new regions and with expanded availability zone support. The update adds deployment options in Denmark East and Austria East, with the content truncated before listing the full set of regions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server pg_ivm extension
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server now supports installing the pg_ivm extension. The feature is generally available.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure DocumentDB instant free tier clusters
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now supports generally available instant free tier cluster provisioning on Azure. The update says free tier clusters can be created with near-instant provisioning so users can start immediately.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure DocumentDB Migration Extension in Visual Studio Code
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB Migration Extension for Visual Studio Code is now generally available. It lets you create, run, and manage migration jobs from VS Code to move data from on-premises or cloud-based MongoDB sources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions now supports hosting MCP Apps
item.description:
Azure Functions now generally supports hosting MCP apps. The update notes that MCP servers can use richer interactions beyond plain text, including visual data exploration, complex configuration, real-time status monitoring, and multi-step workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Agentic Advisor Solution Accelerator
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB Agentic Advisor Solution Accelerator is now generally available. It provides a financial services-focused reference solution for building multi-agent Python applications with LangGraph and Mem0 on Azure HorizonDB.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager for Arc-enabled clusters
item.description:
Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager is now generally available for Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes clusters. This adds support for managing Arc-enabled clusters in Fleet Manager, extending centralized Kubernetes fleet operations across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Logic Apps MCP Server.
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps MCP Server is now generally available, aimed at making existing workflows callable by AI agents and MCP-based tooling without building custom API layers. The update focuses on reducing integration plumbing and operational complexity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Change partition keys in Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL API
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL now supports changing a container’s partition key from the Azure portal. The feature works in both online and offline modes by copying data from the source container to a new container.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Confidential Compute support on Azure Container Apps
item.description:
Azure Container Apps now generally supports Confidential Compute for regulated or sensitive containerized workloads. The feature adds stronger isolation and protection for data while it is being processed.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Content Understanding extractionMode for documents
item.description:
Content Understanding in Microsoft Foundry now supports an extractionMode setting for document analysis. It lets you choose between a layout-aware mode for structured documents and a faster text-only mode.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Document translation for image files (synchronous, single document)
item.description:
Azure AI Translator now generally supports synchronous translation of a single image document in one API call. Supported input includes standalone image files such as JPEG and PNG, with the translated result returned immediately.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: GenAI prompt skill and chat completion in Azure AI Search knowledge sources
item.description:
Azure AI Search now generally supports the GenAI prompt skill, allowing indexers to call chat completion models during enrichment without custom code. The skill can target a Foundry-hosted model and use prompt templates that reference field values.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Image file translation for batch document translation in Azure AI Translator
item.description:
Azure AI Translator batch document translation now generally supports image files as input. It performs OCR on supported image formats and translates the extracted text into the target language.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: LLM Speech API in Azure AI Speech
item.description:
Azure AI Speech has made the LLM Speech API generally available. It adds LLM-based transcription and translation for audio files, supports 25 languages across 90+ locales, and includes accuracy, region, and enhancement updates.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Managed virtual network for evaluations in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now generally supports managed virtual networks for evaluations. This lets cloud evaluation jobs reach models and agents protected by private endpoints using a Foundry-managed VNET for outbound connectivity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Monitor HTTP traffic in Azure Container Apps
item.description:
Azure Container Apps now provides a dedicated Azure Monitor diagnostic setting category, ContainerAppHTTPLogs, for detailed HTTP access logs on incoming traffic. The new category is intended for high-volume request data alongside existing platform-level logs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: OneLake catalog integration for Azure AI Search knowledge sources
item.description:
Azure AI Search’s OneLake catalog integration for knowledge sources is now generally available. Customers can register a OneLake item once and reuse it across multiple knowledge sources and agents, with existing OneLake item-level permissions honored.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Oracle schema conversion to Azure PostgreSQL in Visual Studio Code
item.description:
The PostgreSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now supports converting Oracle database schema objects into Azure Database for PostgreSQL-compatible schema. The workflow is project-based and runs directly in VS Code.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Per-partition automatic failover for Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Per-partition automatic failover (PPAF) is now generally available in Azure Cosmos DB. It allows failover at the partition level instead of failing over an entire account during a regional disruption, improving recovery time and availability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Region-agnostic reservations for Global PTU in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now offers generally available region-agnostic reservations for Global Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs). Customers can reserve PTU capacity once and use it from any supported region instead of being tied to a single region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Service-managed failover in Azure DocumentDB
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB service-managed failover for multi-region clusters is now generally available. In a regional outage, Azure DocumentDB automatically fails over the globally distributed cluster from the primary region to another region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Speech SDK 1.50 for Azure AI Speech
item.description:
Speech SDK 1.50 is now generally available for Azure AI Speech across all supported languages. It provides the latest speech-to-text and text-to-speech updates behind a stable API surface.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: Azure Translator API Version 2026‑06‑06 (GA): Supporting Multilingual Applications with Flexible Translation Options
item.description:
Azure Translator API version 2026-06-06 is now generally available. It adds flexible translation options intended to combine NMT speed, LLM-style fluency, and adaptive translation in a single API.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions Support for Node.js 24
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports Node.js 24 in general availability. Apps can be developed locally with Node.js 24 and deployed to supported Azure Functions plans on Linux and Windows, including Flex Consumption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | May 2026
item.description:
May 2026 Microsoft Foundry updates include trace-based evaluation for any agent on any cloud, new catalog models (Grok 4.3 and DeepSeek V4), GPT-5 Reinforcement Fine-Tuning at gated GA, and several platform and SDK additions. The post also notes GA for Managed VNET and Content Understanding improvements, plus Foundry Local updates and a new azure-ai-projects release.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Application Gateway for Containers – Service Mesh integration with Istio
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers service mesh integration with Istio is now generally available. It automates mTLS connectivity for secure north-south traffic into workloads running in an Istio service mesh.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Multiparty private offers in Microsoft Marketplace expand to 30 countries in Europe
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace multiparty private offers are now generally available in 30 European countries. The update lets partners procure third-party cloud and AI solutions for customers and helps software companies expand into new markets through existing partner relationships.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Virtual network flow logs connector with Microsoft Sentinel
item.description:
Azure virtual network flow logs connector with Microsoft Sentinel is now generally available. It lets you export and analyze network traffic data in Microsoft Sentinel security workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates
